attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), set up nginx serving HTTPS on port 8443 with a self-signed cert (5-min validity for demonstration) that is auto-renewed by a busybox cron job (every minute, renews when <2min of validity remain) via /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh, which atomically replaces cert/key and gracefully reloads nginx (`rc-service nginx reload`) so it picks up the new cert without dropping requests. Verified two live renewals with a continuous HTTPS probe loop showing 100% 200 responses across the cert swap, confirmed both nginx and crond are enabled at boot, restarted node1, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed HTTPS plus a third automatic renewal succeeded post-reboot.
